en_title: Call of Duty's Player Count Dropped by Over 40% Following GTA 6's Release, According to Analysts
cn_title: 分析人士称，《GTA 6》发售后《使命召唤》玩家数量下降超过40%
opus_summary: 据Alinea Analytics统计，《GTA 6》发售后，《使命召唤》应用的跨平台日活跃玩家数量下降42%，从760万降至440万。其中PS5平台降幅最大，玩家数量下降44%。《GTA 6》的PC版据传将于2027年初推出，其线上模式也被广泛猜测会在明年某个时间推出。

paragraphs.en: A new report claims that Call of Duty saw an over 40% drop in players following GTA 6's release.
paragraphs.cn: 一份新报告称，《GTA 6》发售后，《使命召唤》的玩家数量下降了超过40%。

paragraphs.en: We've known all year long that Rockstar Games was going to dominate the final two months of 2026 thanks to the release of GTA 6. It's why a lot of publishers moved their games either into 2027 or pushed them up to September to steer clear of the blast radius. Call of Duty, however, releases on an annual cycle around October or November, which means Modern Warfare 4's post-launch plans were beginning right around the time of GTA 6's launch.
paragraphs.cn: 我们一整年都知道，Rockstar将凭借《GTA 6》的发售主宰2026年的最后两个月。这也是许多发行商将游戏延期至2027年或提前至9月发售，以避开其影响范围的原因。然而，《使命召唤》每年都会在10月或11月左右推出新作，这意味着《Modern Warfare 4》的发售后计划恰好在《GTA 6》发售前后开始。

paragraphs.en: According to Alinea Analytics, it appears that Call of Duty lost almost half of its player base during GTA 6's record-breaking launch weekend . The Call of Duty app (which consists of Warzone, Black Ops 7, and Modern Warfare 4) saw a 42% drop across platforms, taking the overall daily player count from 7.6 million users to 4.4 million users. There's likely a lot of crossover between GTA and Call of Duty's audiences, so it's no surprise to see a drop in players, but nearly half clearly highlights just how much of an event GTA 6 is.
paragraphs.cn: 据Alinea Analytics称，在《GTA 6》打破纪录的发售周末期间，《使命召唤》似乎流失了近一半玩家。《使命召唤》应用（包含《Warzone》、《Black Ops 7》和《Modern Warfare 4》）在各平台的玩家数量下降了42%，每日玩家总数从760万降至440万。《GTA》和《使命召唤》的受众很可能有大量重叠，因此玩家数量下降并不令人意外，但近一半的降幅清楚地凸显了《GTA 6》的发售是多么重大的事件。

paragraphs.en: Call of Duty app (MW4, Warzone, and BO7) lost 42% of players following GTA 6's launch, down from 7.6M daily active users to 4.4M
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA 6》发售后，《使命召唤》应用（《MW4》、《Warzone》和《BO7》）流失了42%的玩家，日活跃用户从760万降至440万。

paragraphs.en: PS5 saw the biggest drop off out of all platforms with 44% decline in players, per Alinea Analytics https://t.co/cARXye3Ahs
paragraphs.cn: 据Alinea Analytics称，PS5在所有平台中降幅最大，玩家数量下降了44%。https://t.co/cARXye3Ahs

paragraphs.en: Earlier this fall, Activision chief marketing officer Tyler Bahl stated that he believed GTA 6 would actually help Call of Duty , as the open-world crime epic would drive more attention toward gaming as a whole. People are buying new consoles or dusting off old ones to play this game, so in theory, they will turn their attention toward other titles once they are done with GTA. Whether that title is Call of Duty remains to be seen, but currently, it appears to only be hurting the series in the immediate short term. Things will probably bounce back up, but it'll be interesting to see how many people return.
paragraphs.cn: 今年秋季早些时候，动视首席营销官Tyler Bahl表示，他认为《GTA 6》实际上会对《使命召唤》有所帮助，因为这款开放世界犯罪史诗游戏会让更多人关注游戏行业整体。人们正在购买新主机或掸去旧主机上的灰尘来玩这款游戏，因此理论上，他们玩完《GTA》后会将注意力转向其他游戏。他们转向的游戏是否会是《使命召唤》还有待观察，但目前看来，它在眼下的短期内似乎只是在损害这个系列。情况可能会回升，但会有多少人回来将值得关注。

paragraphs.en: This also may not be the last time Call of Duty takes a hit from GTA 6. There are expected to be at least two more big beats or launches for this game, with the PC release rumored for an early 2027 release . However, the even bigger moment will come in the form in the inevitable online mode. Rockstar hasn't talked about its plans for GTA 6's online offerings yet, but it's highly speculated to release sometime next year . If it drops in the summer, it may not hurt Call of Duty a ton since that is the period where the most hardcore fans are still grinding away on the game.
paragraphs.cn: 这也可能不是《使命召唤》最后一次受到《GTA 6》的冲击。预计这款游戏还会有至少两次重大节点或发售，传闻PC版将在2027年初推出。然而，更重大的时刻将是必然会推出的线上模式。Rockstar尚未谈及《GTA 6》线上内容的计划，但外界普遍猜测它会在明年某个时候推出。如果它在夏季推出，可能不会对《使命召唤》造成太大损害，因为那段时间仍在游戏中努力游玩的是最硬核的粉丝。

paragraphs.en: But if GTA 6 Online dropped next fall, around October or November, it could put Call of Duty in a really difficult position. It'll be an interesting story to follow, but Call of Duty has been battling intense competition for two straight years now thanks to Battlefield 6 in 2025 and GTA 6 this year. Maybe it can contend next year, but the jury is still out.
paragraphs.cn: 但如果《GTA 6 Online》在明年秋季，也就是10月或11月左右推出，就可能让《使命召唤》陷入非常困难的境地。这将是一件值得关注的事，但由于2025年的《战地风云6》和今年的《GTA 6》，《使命召唤》已经连续两年面临激烈竞争。也许它明年能够与之抗衡，但现在还无法下定论。
